en.headline: 14-month-old girl dies from influenza A, third child fatality this season
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the previously healthy toddler, who developed fever and convulsions in late October, died today after multi-organ failure.
body: The Centre for Health Protection announced that a 14-month-old girl infected with influenza A passed away on Friday, becoming the third paediatric fatality in Hong Kong’s current influenza season.

The child, who had been in good health, developed a fever and cough on 26 October. The following day she suffered a convulsion and was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital before being transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit at United Christian Hospital. Laboratory tests confirmed influenza A (H1), and clinicians diagnosed the infection as complicated by acute necrotising encephalopathy and multi-organ failure. She had not received the seasonal influenza vaccine and had no travel history during the incubation period.

Hong Kong entered the influenza season in late June. The latest surveillance shows overall activity has declined but remains above baseline levels. A total of 29 severe paediatric cases have been recorded this season: 22 patients have recovered and been discharged, two remain in stable condition, two are in critical condition, and three have died.

The Controller of the Centre for Health Protection, Dr Edwin Tsui, reminded the public that Hong Kong is still in the influenza season. He noted that data from the previous year showed unvaccinated children faced roughly five times the rate of severe complications or death compared with vaccinated children. The centre urged everyone aged six months or older, except those with known contraindications, to receive the seasonal influenza vaccine promptly if they have not already done so.

zh.headline: 14個月大女童感染甲型流感不治 今年第三宗兒童死亡個案
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，早前健康的女童上月底發燒抽搐後，今日因多重器官衰竭離世。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心公布，一名14個月大女童感染甲型流感後於周五不治，成為本港今個流感季節第三宗兒童死亡個案。
該女童早前健康，10月26日出現發燒及咳嗽，翌日抽搐後被送往將軍澳醫院急症室，隨後轉往聯合醫院兒童深切治療部。化驗證實呼吸道樣本對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發急性壞死性腦病變及多重器官衰竭。她未有接種季節性流感疫苗，潛伏期內亦無外遊紀錄。
本港自6月下旬進入流感季節。最新監測數據顯示整體流感活躍程度已出現下降，但仍高於基線水平。今季累計錄得29宗兒童嚴重個案，其中22宗已康復出院、兩宗情況穩定、兩宗情況危殆，另有三宗死亡。
衞生防護中心總監徐樂堅醫生提醒市民，本港仍處於流感季節。他指出，上一年度數據顯示，未接種疫苗的兒童感染後出現嚴重併發症或死亡的比率，約為已接種者的五倍。中心呼籲所有年滿六個月或以上人士，除有已知禁忌症者外，若尚未接種季節性流感疫苗，應從速接種。
